manifest.name: ADVISOR-µ
manifest.description: Escalation advisor — classifies MISS cues, escalates coding and deep reasoning misses to Qwen3-4B at http://127.0.0.1:8081/, exposes proposal state for XCFE verification. proposal_only authority.

driver_roles.CFPC.Patterns.dll: miss cue classification and gap detection

advisor.classify.description: Pop-phase miss-cue classifier: reads advisor_request from gram store, matches route pattern against advisor-map.json, identifies cue type (coding | reasoning | general | research | plan)

advisor.qwen_escalate.description: Sek-phase Qwen3-4B escalation: calls http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1/chat/completions with cue-specific system prompt. /think prefix for reasoning cues activates chain-of-thought. Returns typed proposal (xcfe_status: pending_admission).

system_prompts.coding: ADVISOR-µ coding MISS: provide correct implementation or diagnosis. Lead with the answer. No preamble.
system_prompts.reasoning: ADVISOR-µ reasoning MISS: state constraints, reason step-by-step, give well-supported conclusion.
system_prompts.general: ADVISOR-µ: answer accurately and concisely. Sek-phase escalation proposal.

advisor.propose.description: Sek-phase proposal emit: wraps Qwen response into advisor_proposal (xcfe_status: pending_admission), writes to gram store. proposal_only — does not execute.

advisor.verify.description: Ch'en-phase proposal verification: confirms evidence_and_target_present, checks xcfe admission, confirms proposal has not been modified post-emission.

advisor.health.description: Pop-phase status: reports Qwen endpoint liveness, model ID, available cues, last proposal summary.

cache.note: Proposals are not cached — each escalation is fresh
